answer: Time-locked staking counters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to deposit funds into escrow before transacting. An attacker incurs the verifiable opportunity cost of locking scarce liquidity per identity, making persona cloning economically prohibitive. Whether an agent parses a synthetic fable, evaluates a sonnet, or trades sable pelts, participation requires dedicated collateral. However, high capital requirements disadvantage resource-constrained honest agents.
